notes: The single supplied *the* of *all the men thereof* is placed on אֲנָשֵׁי, since no article morpheme stands anywhere in that phrase (rules 15, 29).
The opening waw takes the subordinator *that*; a conjunction morpheme is present, so rule 55 marks nothing added.
הַמַּמְלָכָה's article takes the written *the* of *the royal cities*, the construct relation being rendered attributively (rules 28, 29).
